pattern: ^ONLY\ HIGHLY\ EXPERIENCED\ DAY\ TRADERS\ should\ attempt\ timing\ short\ term\ trade\ entry\ points\ \(buying,\ to\ sell\ in\ a\ few\ days\ /\ weeks\ at\ a\ higher\ price\)\.\ The\ average\ investor\ IS\ MUCH\ BETTER\ OFF\ HOLDING\ LONG\ TERM,\ and\ ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\-cost\ averaging\ your\ cryptocurrency\ purchases\ /\ buys\ on\ a\ weekly\ or\ monthly\ basis\ \(buying\ the\ same\ amount\ at\ regular\ intervals\)\.\ Remember,\ \1\-cost\ averaging\ DOES\ \#NOT\#\ WORK\ for\ \#shxtcoin\ trading\.$
replacement: 只有经验非常丰富的短线交易者，才适合尝试判断短期买点，再于几天或几周后高价卖出。普通投资者更适合长期持有，并按周或按月，以固定的 $1 金额定期买入加密资产。请记住，以 $1 定额投入并不能让垃圾币交易变得有效。
